Mean customer service
Jul 2019 • Friends
This place charged us for a $20 shisha that we couldn't even smoke because it was faulty and we had to return it. We ordered 2 shishas at $20 each, 1 worked fine but the other didn't smoke properly so we returned it after a few minutes of trying to smoke it. When we got the bill, the total bill was about $60 including drinks and the 2 pipes. I said why are you charging us for the pipe we couldn't smoke, they said you have to pay for it. I said you should at least give us a discount because we couldn't even smoke it, and they eventually gave us a tiny 5% discount for that pipe, wow. I won't be back, mean customer service.
